place: Choeng Mon, Koh Samui, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: New Three-Bedroom Sea-View Pool Villa a Short Walk from Choeng Mon Beach
blurb: A new, contemporary two-level villa with sea views, a short walk from Choeng Mon Beach — three en-suite bedrooms, a private pool and a large lounge terrace on the upper floor, with parking and utilities below. Furnished with handcrafted Balinese pieces, from ฿19.9M, freehold or leasehold.
detail:
A short walk from the calm sands of Choeng Mon Beach, this new villa is planned vertically to make the most of its elevation. The ground level holds private parking and the technical rooms, so the whole of the upper floor is given over to living: an open lounge, dining area and kitchen, three bedrooms, and a private swimming pool set within a broad pool deck and a large terrace with a lounge area, all looking toward the sea.

Each of the three bedrooms is en-suite and comes with a king-size bed, a wardrobe and a desk, so the house works equally well for a family, for friends sharing, or for someone who works from home part of the year. Ceilings are high, glazing is full-height and the palette is quiet — pale floors, white walls and warm timber.

The furniture throughout is handcrafted by artisans from Bali, and the villa is offered furnished. With 111 m² of living space on a 230 m² plot, it is compact enough to be easy to run and private enough to feel like a retreat, and it suits both owner-occupiers and those planning to rent it out. Available on either a freehold or leasehold basis.

features.l: Sea views from the upper-level living floor
Private pool, pool deck & lounge terrace
King bed, wardrobe & desk in every bedroom
Private parking & technical rooms at ground level
Short walk to Choeng Mon Beach
